predictions.articleTitle: Nottingham Forest vs Chelsea Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Forest's xG Crack Chelsea's Backline?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Nottingham Forest's 1.61 expected goals per match and Callum Hudson-Odoi's return position the hosts to avoid defeat in an open encounter against Chelsea.
possibilityAssessment: Thesis 1: Home Win / Draw leads as Forest's 43.83% blended win model edge combines with a 25.81% draw cover against conversion variance (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Thesis 2: Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS: Yes align with a 3.01 combined lambda and weak clean-sheet records on both sides (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Thesis 3: A 1:1 Draw hedge captures the 11.2% modal scoreline if Forest's 79.3% big-chance waste persists against Moises Caicedo's returning midfield shield (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
